**Title:** Revert "VideoCommon: Use correct size for PE token"

Fixes regression introduced in #14842.

name: Dolphin PR #14789: Optimize vertex_shader_uid_data down to 28 bytes + Custom Storage Location
body:
Built from custom master branch, merged with the custom user data storage location feature (Scoped Storage / Internal Storage / SD Card) and Games on Wii Menu Patch.

Built from upstream Dolphin PR `#14789`.

### Upstream Dolphin PR [#14789](https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/pull/14789)
**Title:** Optimize vertex_shader_uid_data down to 28 bytes
**Author:** [@phire](https://github.com/phire)

#### PR Description
This started as a fixing a misalignment issue, but I got carried away. Was originally 41 bytes (overflowing it's expected 40 bytes by 1 bit).

Now it's 27 bytes with 8 bits of padding (ready for future expansion).

The savings come from:
 - Removing UV usage from components, it can be reconstructed from texcoord_elem_count (saved 8 bits)
 - Removed the 8 unused bits from texMtxInfo_n_projection (saved 8 bits)
 - Removing unused bit from from start of components (saved 1 bit)
 - Removed extra bit from inputform, texgentype and sourcerow
 - packed texMtxInfo_n_projection and texcoord_elem_count back into the per texgen info space freed up above. (saved 24 bits)
 - Overlayed postMtx index and Emboss mode shifts into a union based on texgentype (saved 56 bits)
 - Move to a single-bit union tag, freeing up an extra bit for regular texgens.
 - Move PotMtx normalize into the freed up space (saved 8 bits)

Total savings: 105 bits of data

EDIT: Even worse, MSVC wasn't respecting pack(1) for bitfields at all, so on windows this struct was actually quite a bit larger. Something like 80 bytes, if not more. So this PR cuts vertex UID size by almost 75%. 

Fixed this by dropping the size of any enums used in these bit structs to u8. Our Common::BitField allows for the underlying type to be explicitly specified to something larger.

msvc's bitfield packing appears to be completely braindead, can't mix sizes at all. (fortunately, bool counts as u8) 

This is an unofficial community build, not affiliated with the Dolphin team.

name: Dolphin PR #14838: MemArenaDarwin: Pass the MAP_MEM_VM_SHARE flag to mach_make_memory_entry_64 + Custom Storage Location
body:
Built from custom master branch, merged with the custom user data storage location feature (Scoped Storage / Internal Storage / SD Card) and Games on Wii Menu Patch.

Built from upstream Dolphin PR `#14838`.

### Upstream Dolphin PR [#14838](https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/pull/14838)
**Title:** MemArenaDarwin: Pass the MAP_MEM_VM_SHARE flag to mach_make_memory_entry_64
**Author:** [@OatmealDome](https://github.com/OatmealDome)

#### PR Description
This fixes a panic alert and crash on macOS when overriding MEM1/MEM2 sizes.

Large anonymous mappings are split into 128 MB chunks. Without `MAP_MEM_VM_SHARE`, `mach_make_memory_entry_64` will only return an entry spanning the first chunk. Attempting to map through that entry will fail if it extends beyond the 128 MB boundary, which can happen when the sizes of MEM1/MEM2 are overridden.

(And yes, this new flag is inserted with the memory protection flags. Weird API.)

name: Dolphin PR #14846: HW/EXI: Don’t dereference one item past end of array + Custom Storage Location
body:
Built from custom master branch, merged with the custom user data storage location feature (Scoped Storage / Internal Storage / SD Card) and Games on Wii Menu Patch.

Built from upstream Dolphin PR `#14846`.

### Upstream Dolphin PR [#14846](https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/pull/14846)
**Title:** HW/EXI: Don’t dereference one item past end of array
**Author:** [@linkmauve](https://github.com/linkmauve)

#### PR Description
Dolphin would previously crash while accessing `&buffer[got]`, as if we were trying to access that element instead of just obtaining a pointer to it.  The proper solution is to obtain a pointer to the first element, and only add the offset we want to get the range.

Here is the printed message:
```
/usr/include/c++/16/array:210: constexpr std::array<_Tp, _Nm>::value_type& std::array<_Tp, _Nm>::operator[](size_type) [with _Tp = char; long unsigned int _Nm = 128; reference = char&; size_type = long unsigned int]: Assertion '__n < this->size()' failed.
```

The stack trace originates from: [Source/Core/Core/HW/EXI/EXI_DeviceGecko.cpp:139](https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/blob/ca8c6ee45e419296226e4da8c2b2adaaf54e0299/Source/Core/Core/HW/EXI/EXI_DeviceGecko.cpp#L139)

name: Dolphin PR #14837: VideoCommon: separate out reinterpret and palette texture creation from rendering + Custom Storage Location
body:
Built from custom master branch, merged with the custom user data storage location feature (Scoped Storage / Internal Storage / SD Card) and Games on Wii Menu Patch.

Built from upstream Dolphin PR `#14837`.

### Upstream Dolphin PR [#14837](https://github.com/dolphin-emu/dolphin/pull/14837)
**Title:** VideoCommon: separate out reinterpret and palette texture creation from rendering
**Author:** [@iwubcode](https://github.com/iwubcode)

#### PR Description
Late last year I started working on a new feature that required Dolphin to think about how it renders in a different way. In order to prepare for that, I will be creating some PRs that restructure or refactor our existing code.

This PR is for the texture cache. All it does is separate out the rendering of palette and reinterpret paths from the actual texture entry creation.  This one isn't very exciting but I swear there's more excitement coming!

Functionality should not change with these PRs. I did some mild testing but fifo ci should hopefully confirm if any changes slipped through.

name: LeviLaunchroid v1.5.22 (r4)
body:
## LeviLauncher v1.5.22

This update adds foreground service support, improved gyroscope sensitivity, an external mods catalog, mod scanning improvements, redesigned content management, and updated translations.

### Features

- [Added foreground service support to keep Minecraft active while the launcher is in the background.](https://github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLaunchroid/commit/bad68971aa17b8fd45096c86fe632fcfa89d22b6)
- [Greatly increased gyroscope sensitivity and improved gyro controls.](https://github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLaunchroid/commit/7df568702dae976734fddeeaed9685a31e63ccb7)
- [Added an external mods catalog with built-in mod download functionality.](https://github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLaunchroid/commit/fae70e53378b7d9b90487addbaca32ef60b13d29)
- [Added a Community Discord button and improved scanned mods so users can choose which mods to add.](https://github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLaunchroid/commit/e867b9fa87d8a236fac9d3c60b8e0e1c9f09b923)

### Improvements

- [Redesigned the custom flat world editor.](https://github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLaunchroid/commit/2c0224728cdc930190647523726c2f01cc9dfcb7)
- [Redesigned content management lists for a cleaner and easier-to-use interface.](https://github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLaunchroid/commit/c71c5247dffd9a678c67ceb419c9f725dbdb7bb7)
- [Updated and completed strings and translations across supported languages.](https://github.com/LiteLDev/LeviLaunchroid/commit/54902df4f923b4237bb4b6cb23378f69575bc674)

name: Pull request #4169: [audio] Replace libopus with FFmpeg
body:
Pull request build #[4169](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/pulls/4169)

Commit: [`ff8368c6066faf3962e2f77af7da4954e2ff6a43`](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/commit/ff8368c6066faf3962e2f77af7da4954e2ff6a43)

Merge base: [`ff8368c606`](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/commit/ff8368c606)
([Master Build](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-ci/master/releases?q=ff8368c606&expanded=true))

## Changelog
FFmpeg offers two opus decoders:
- libopus, this one is fed the same data (that affects output) as the previous libopus decoder had as well
- native opus decoder: this only takes Float32 samples, we then need to invoke swrescale to translate between s16 (what switch sends) and float32 (what FFmpeg expects), the process is computationally more expensive, but trades off neatly as the native opus decoder is very optimised

It also relegates the handling to FFmpeg, which simplifies existing code (more concretely, by using the "fill/drain" scheme for packets/frames)

Closes #2897

Signed-off-by: lizzie <lizzie@eden-emu.dev>

name: Pull request #4395: [gpu] Fix infinite hangup/freezes at shutdown/reset
body:
Pull request build #[4395](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/pulls/4395)

Commit: [`c95ad020fb529d47f9c3106a53553bec955c1586`](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/commit/c95ad020fb529d47f9c3106a53553bec955c1586)

Merge base: [`c95ad020fb`](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/commit/c95ad020fb)
([Master Build](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-ci/master/releases?q=c95ad020fb&expanded=true))

## Changelog
Thread may be destroyed at dtor(), but it hasn't fully shut down, so before notify shutdown, request immediate stop (effective immediately).

Like the issue was that the thread didn't want to stop running, thus it would hang, it would also reference objects which were being destroyed without waiting for them to actually be destroyed
So it would reference invalid data
This PR tells the thread: "hey, STOP now, and DESTROY yourself"
So all of that should be avoided

name: Pull request #4375: [fs] moved temp folder cleanup upstream (per-application level) to avoid per-program retrigger
body:
Pull request build #[4375](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/pulls/4375)

Commit: [`f3af5d0c252feba0df73bedddcd8a40f71ebc0fa`](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/commit/f3af5d0c252feba0df73bedddcd8a40f71ebc0fa)

Merge base: [`f3af5d0c25`](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/commit/f3af5d0c25)
([Master Build](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-ci/master/releases?q=f3af5d0c25&expanded=true))

## Changelog
- [x] I have read and followed the [Contribution Guidelines](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/src/branch/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-contributions).
- [x] I have read and followed the [AI Policy](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/src/branch/master/docs/policies/AI.md)
- [x] I have read and followed the [Coding Guidelines](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/src/branch/master/docs/policies/Coding.md) to the best of my ability.

-------------------

This issue was observed in MGS Master Collection Volume II, MGS4: Guns of the Patriots, Chapter 4: Shadow Moses

That title is a bundle, and that specific chapter is a program (MGS 1st stage), launched by a program (MGS4), launched by an application (main title bundle).

Upon decoding guest panic message, it was exposed that an abort was triggered after trying to create a save in nand/temp/gclvar.bak file.
Further instrumentation exposed the error on that file's path, caused from a previous deletion of that folder.
In the same session that folder had been already cleaned and created successfully, which evidences an undesired re-cleaning of the temp structure.

The issue was the fact that the MGS4 to MGS transition also calls EnsureSaveData>...>SaveDataFactory creator, and that was destroying the previous created temp structure. After that stage, the return from MSG to MSG4 was causing the same issue again.

By moving the deletion to the guest application level, the factory creation was called only once, as it should be, and the issue is gone.

name: Pull request #4344: vulkan: force subgroup-in-geometry fallback on Turnip
body:
Pull request build #[4344](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/pulls/4344)

Commit: [`b8465770370049eb222769254d773174e1323125`](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/commit/b8465770370049eb222769254d773174e1323125)

Merge base: [`e5b656e372`](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/commit/e5b656e372)
([Master Build](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-ci/master/releases?q=e5b656e372&expanded=true))

## Changelog
Turnip reports VK_SHADER_STAGE_GEOMETRY_BIT in
supportedStages, but its ballot/shuffle results in the
geometry stage are wrong, corrupting the compaction-based
draws (missing/incorrect meshes and textures observed in
NieR Automata). Vendor Qualcomm drivers don't advertise
geometry support and use the existing fallback correctly.
Force the fallback on Turnip too, ignoring the advertised
capability.

name: Pull request #4219: [common/core/dynarmic] Optimize page table allocations
body:
Pull request build #[4219](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/pulls/4219)

Commit: [`5f142c7926d0c7fcbbd0ce30794d72f638a43b2a`](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/commit/5f142c7926d0c7fcbbd0ce30794d72f638a43b2a)

Merge base: [`4c65780f11`](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-emu/eden/commit/4c65780f11)
([Master Build](https://git.eden-emu.dev/eden-ci/master/releases?q=4c65780f11&expanded=true))

## Changelog
Reduces the page entries from 32 bytes to 8 and rewrites `VirtualBuffer` to be more efficient in memory usage and specifically for large zero regions.

The page table will now only reserve 1GiB instead of 4GiB and of this memory it should only use at most ~8MiB.

This PR has the side effect of using Eden on Windows on low memory systems much more plausible since it would previously require ~10GiB of committable memory at front (despite using ~5-6 at most, inadvertently stalling other processes) where as now it should only require around the amount that it'll actually use.

name: Zalith Launcher 2.5.1 + Extra (Update 6)
body:
Built from custom main branch of ZalithLauncher2-Extra, with enhanced features and optimizations.

Synced with upstream ZalithLauncher2 [`2.5.1`](https://github.com/ZalithLauncher/ZalithLauncher2/releases/tag/2.5.1).

#### Upstream Release Notes
## Updates:
- #0e1b12d: Integrated JSound into LWJGL (by @ShirosakiMio)

## Changes:
- #1797: Limit joystick resize via drag handle to the size allowed by properties (by @youfeng11)
- #1799: Increased polling sample rate for joystick in controller mapping mode, and normalized offsets by actual interval (by @MovTery)

## Fixes:
- #1789: CurseForge downloads failing (by @MovTery)
- #1793: Window size oscillation in picture-in-picture/split-screen mode causing severe screen flickering (by @MovTery)
- #1793: Control layout not functioning properly when window size changes (by @MovTery)
- #1794: Keep-alive foreground service startup timeout causing game process crash (by @MovTery)
- #1795: Single click on hotbar slot triggering the switch key twice (by @MovTery)
- #1798: ENOENT error when saving control layout due to external storage issues (by @MovTery)

This is an unofficial community build of Zalith Launcher 2 Extra.
